verdict.rationale: First-party quickstart docs name 'the Agents CLI' as one of the official ways to manage ElevenLabs Agents, so an official CLI exists. That is the only mention: there is no documentation of its commands, installation, or AI-native workflow use. The 'npx skills add' agents skill and the hosted MCP server are adjacent agent integrations, not the CLI itself, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: CLI command reference and installation docs, evidence of scripted or agent-driven CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: ElevenLabs Agents are managed either through the ElevenAgents dashboard, the ElevenLabs API, the Agents CLI or the hosted MCP server.
